about_the_game:
PRELUDE DARK PAIN is a TACTICAL RPG set in a dark fantasy world where you will become one of a group of heroes, determined to save reality from the evil that has afflicted it for generations.

Take command of a group that will follow you to the end of the world

The local blacksmith Soren will confront the ghosts of his past to put an end to the dark ritual initiated by the inquisitive Order of the Crusade of Ashes. Pick up your weapons and lead a crew of soldiers from different backgrounds that you can recruit from all over Estátera.

Customize your team for any task

Choose from more than 20 unique characters, each with two branches of talents and 24 skills, to design the ideal group for each mission. Manage your resources and your squad of heroes to overcome challenges both in and out of battle.

Diverse strategy missions

Face dozens of missions with their own mechanics in which you will manage shipments of groups of 1 to 3 heroes. Overcome missions of escort, search for resources, diplomacy, espionage or defense work to expand your influence and improve your team.

Get ready for combat with a complex management system

Many of your heroes have unique abilities focused on raids, making them special and valuable inside and outside the battle lines. You will have to manage a settlement, grow it, and expand your control and resources of the different maps as another playable part of your adventure.

Discover a dark story about a primordial evil

Follow a complex non-linear open-world story that will lead you to unravel an incredible story. The different realities of a destroyed world will be involved in a plot that has been secretly unfolding for thousands of years.

Decide the fate of a world in danger

You will feel the real weight of your decisions that will change the story that is being told in front of you, accompanied by a countdown that will take you to complete the adventure unifying more than 20 nations and cultures, 8 different playable species among all the realities and more than 70 different enemies in this exciting adventure.
